forgotten_tribe_interpretation.decision: Apply the explicit Robber Flees desert instruction as an event-specific exception. Keep the ordinary numbered-terrain restriction for sevens and Knights. This is an interpretation combining the printed rules, not a claim of a dedicated FAQ.
